She also failed to pick up on bruising from a bad fall in the shower on the same day as the chest infection mistake, which happened in a second and caused more back pain and tailbone pain. I had two hospital visits in one week to correct her mistakes. Maybe they were talking to my mums heart when she died on the table at the Royal on the 15th October 2019 instead of doing the actual surgery! They’re just obsessed with reducing your acute medications. My mums brother Will was the top consultant microbiologist in NI until recently. My cousin Tanya is a doctor in immunology in the Royal and yes,  I am close to them. My mum was a nurse for 38 years. My mums other brother was head of the chemistry department at banbridge academy and his two sons, one is a doctor in Manchester and one is a dentist in Newcastle upon Tyne, so there’s plenty of doctors in my family, I don’t need to gave them respect unless they deserve it, and doctor McKee definitely doesn’t deserve any respect! Luckily I’ll never be back with her, two times is enough, what a waste of my time!
